articles.title: Nvidia Looks for a New Era After Huang
articles.description: Bloomberg’s Emily Chang tells Bloomberg This Weekend what her recent interview with Jensen Huang reveals about Nvidia’s succession challenge after the longtime CEO’s abrupt departure. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Chang examines who could succeed Huang, the questions surrounding Nvidia’s China strategy and whether the AI giant can preserve the influence and relationships Huang built over more than three decades. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Arm Is Up 77% Even As Profit Fell
articles.description: If you had tuned in only for the legal headlines around Arm and Qualcomm, you might assume Arm’s shareholders were punished, not rewarded. Holding Arm from the start of the year would have returned 77.3%, including dividends. That gain came through a period that featured sector selloffs, supply concerns, and valuation debates. If you were deciding on 1 January 2026, what did the available information really say about taking that ride with Arm? Narratives are how investors here put a case on...
